title: Name the pattern from the signal in the question
takeaway: Each problem is one of about fifteen patterns, and a word in the question tells you which.
sources: Most coding interview problems are the same fifteen or so problems wearing different clothes.
The word contiguous is the signal.
A useful test: after solving a problem, close it and write down the pattern name and the trigger in one sentence.
Patterns solve exactly one problem: the blank page at minute one of a coding interview.

pairs.signal: have I seen this, count, group
how many ways, min or max cost
